WITH RECURSIVE customer_date_ranges AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(txn_date::DATE) as min_date,
        MAX(txn_date::DATE) as max_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
date_series AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        min_date as txn_date
    FROM customer_date_ranges
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        ds.customer_id,
        ds.txn_date + INTERVAL '1 day'
    FROM date_series ds
    JOIN customer_date_ranges cd ON ds.customer_id = cd.customer_id
    WHERE ds.txn_date + INTERVAL '1 day' <= cd.max_date
),
transactions_with_amount AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.customer_id,
        ct.txn_date::DATE as txn_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN ct.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN ct.txn_amount
            ELSE -ct.txn_amount
        END as amount
    FROM customer_transactions ct
    WHERE ct.txn_date IS NOT NULL
),
daily_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        ds.customer_id,
        ds.txn_date,
        COALESCE(amount, 0) as amount
    FROM date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN transactions_with_amount tw ON ds.customer_id = tw.customer_id AND ds.txn_date = tw.txn_date
),
daily_running_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as balance
    FROM daily_transactions
),
daily_balances_adjusted AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        CASE WHEN balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE balance END as adjusted_balance,
        CAST(txn_date AS TEXT) as txn_date_str,
        CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date_date,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', txn_date) as txn_month
    FROM daily_running_balance
),
customer_month_max AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_month,
        MAX(adjusted_balance) as max_daily_balance
    FROM daily_balances_adjusted
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_month
),
monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        txn_month,
        SUM(max_daily_balance) as monthly_total
    FROM customer_month_max
    GROUP BY txn_month
)
SELECT * FROM monthly_totals ORDER BY txn_month
